project.boundarySource: Curated visitor envelope derived from the OpenStreetMap settlement point, with adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 2 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 3 of 25 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Nether Alderley qualifies as a local detour through Church of St Mary and Churchyard cross at St Mary's Church. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Nether Alderley: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Nether Alderley offers Church of St Mary, Churchyard cross at St Mary's Church, Churchyard Cross within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Church of St Mary
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Church of St Mary and Churchyard cross at St Mary's Church, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.

dontMiss: Churchyard cross at St Mary's Church
